messages:
anya: Quick sync — planning Q3 work for the Optimize toolkit + evals. Goal: ship recommendations + regression alerts + canonical prompt sets for customers. What should be in v1 vs v2?

raj: +1. Can you list concrete deliverables? also need to know runtime deps (cache metrics, batching knobs).

anya: Proposed v1 deliverables:
- API/CLI that returns batching and caching recommendations for a given workload profile (model family, sequence distribution, qconfig)
- Eval harness that runs prompt sets and emits regression metrics (delta in BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim)
- Small canonical prompt set repo for 3 verticals (support, summarization, search)
- Docs + quickstart example and sample telemetry dashboard

mel: For the evals: suggest we include both semantic similarity (embeddings) and token-level metrics. Also mock replay harness to simulate prefix cache hits. We'll need a synthetic workload generator.

jorge: infra constraints: to produce meaningful recommendations we need runtime telemetry: per-route p50/p95 latency, per-token cost, batch size histograms, and cache hit ratio. Those are not all in tracing today. I'll need an events schema and a short rollout to capture it.

anya: Noted. Proposal: capture a small telemetry set (batchSize, tokens, cacheHit boolean, latency_ms, model_name) — that should be enough to drive heuristics. Raj / eng: can you add a telemetry event in the serving runtime?

raj: I can add a lightweight event with schema similar to above. Timeline: 2 sprint spikes for instrumentation + 1 sprint for recommender prototype.

sophie: From CS — a couple of customers asked specifically for: (1) deterministic recommendations they can pin (2) audit logs showing when suggestions changed (3) guardrails for bursty workloads. FinBank is very vocal about auditability.

anya: Good to capture. For v1 we can make recommendations reversible and produce an "explain" payload with inputs and expected savings. Audit logs can be exported to customer's workspace.

raj: Question on launch criteria: do we need an ML model for recommendations or heuristics are fine for v1? heuristics would be faster to ship.

mel: Heuristics + rules for common patterns should cover 70-80% of cases. We can ship a small supervised model in v2 if customers want more granular gains. The eval harness should be model-agnostic.

anya: Draft launch criteria (vote):
- Recommender API returns suggestions for at least 3 model families (Llama-like, MPT-like, GPT-style)
- Recommendations validated on 5 internal workloads showing >=15% cost reduction or no >10% latency regression (must pass one of these)
- Eval harness runs nightly on canonical prompt sets and raises regression alerts with clear triage steps
- Docs + quickstart + one customer pilot completed

jorge: +1 to those. Also add: instrumentation coverage >=90% for routes used in pilot.

sophie: From customer perspective add SLA on false positives — we can't change recommended configs on prod without an explicit approval flow. So output should be "recommended" not auto-applied.

anya: Agreed — recommendations are advisory. We'll add a canary/preview UI in Console v1 for customers to inspect before applying. That UI can be read-only in v1 (no apply button). Save apply for v2.

raj: Scope tradeoff: UI + Console integration will add 3-4 weeks. If we cut UI we can focus on API, CLI, evals and instrumentation and hit Q3 target. Thoughts?

mel: I'd cut UI for v1. v1 value is in the API + eval loop + pilot. Console is a good v2.

anya: Lean consensus: cut full console integration for v1, provide a CLI + sample notebook + exportable JSON for Console import later. Update OKRs accordingly.

deploy-bot: build/optimize-recommender: CI passed for prototype tests (jenkins/opt-123) :white_check_mark:

anya: Next steps / owners:
- Raj: telemetry instrumentation + prototype recommender (owner) — RFC by next Wed
- Mel: eval harness & canonical prompt set curation (owner) — initial repo + 3 vertical sets by EoQ
- Jorge: telemetry schema + infra retention plan (owner) — plan doc by end of sprint
- Sophie: customer pilot coordination (owner) — recruit 2 pilots this quarter
- Me (anya): product specs, launch criteria, OKR mapping, stakeholder syncs

mel: small tech note: include a "replay token" in telemetry so eval harness can deterministically replay workloads to test cache effects.

raj: ack. Will add replay token field.

anya: Can we get a quick decision on the numeric OKR target? I'm proposing: "Optimize toolkit reduces per-token unit cost by 20% on pilot workloads" (stretch 30%). Agree?

sophie: Customers will celebrate 20%. 👍

jorge: 20% seems aggressive but OK as an OKR stretch. We should measure both cost and latency and include a risk flag if latency increases >10%.

anya: Final: set OKR target 20% cost reduction (stretch 30%), latency guardrail 10% p95 increase, nightly evals + regression alerts enabled. I'll draft the PRD and share later today.

raj: cool. I'll carve out time for the instrumentation spike.

mel: I'll start curating prompt sets and write a minimal runner.

sophie: I'll reach out to FinBank + one PLG customer for pilots.

anya: Thanks all — will post the PRD link here when ready. :rocket:
